node.statement: Take D_0=2 and e_0=1/4. For epsilon<=t<=e_0, node 1.1 and the defining unit-norm bound | ||I_A||-1 |<=epsilon in the epsilon-C*-algebra A give (1-epsilon)||X||<=||v_n(X)||_n=||X||||I_A||<=(1+epsilon)||X||, hence (1-2t)||X||<=||v_n(X)||_n<=(1+2t)||X||. The preceding homomorphism node gives 2epsilon-homomorphism defect at most 2t at every n. Therefore v is an extended 2t-inclusion by def-extended-delta-inclusion.
